title: wpa_211_requests
description: REAL 2-1-1 helpline requests across the 25 Western Pennsylvania counties served by the United Way of Southwestern Pennsylvania, one row per request, the upstream resource entire (2023-09-22 .. 2025-08-27, no window and no sample - see gen_wpa_211_requests.py). Used to demonstrate a denominator-aware region map on a real service log rather than a synthetic one. No population column is carried on purpose: the rate panel's denominator is FETCHED by --denominator census@2024, and the county boundaries by --geojson auto, which also canonicalizes the county NAMES below to Census GEOIDs so the fetched population keys onto them.

contact_date.title: Contact Date
contact_date.description: Date the request reached the 2-1-1 helpline.

county.title: County
county.description: County of the caller, normalized to the '<Name> County' spelling by the generator (the upstream 2020-2023 and 2023-2025 resources disagree on the suffix). The ONLY region concept in this dictionary, deliberately: the upstream feed also carries a zip_code, and tagging it geo.* would create a competing choropleth candidate scoring against a county-keyed map. All 25 names are Pennsylvania counties and are unique within the state, so - unlike tristate_county_incidents - they need no state qualifier to stop the frequency bar silently summing namesakes.

state.title: State
state.description: Constant by construction - this is the Western Pennsylvania 2-1-1 region. Carried so --geojson auto scopes its boundary fetch to one state rather than probing the nation.

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: Self-reported gender of the caller, where recorded.

age_range.title: Age Range
age_range.description: Banded age of the caller, where recorded.

level_1_classification.title: Need Group
level_1_classification.description: Top level of the AIRS/211 taxonomy for the need behind the request - Basic Needs, Income Support and Employment, and so on. The feed's finer taxonomy levels are dropped by the generator: level_2_classification has 66 values and needs_category 826, both past the point where a frequency bar reads.

needs_met.title: Need Met
needs_met.description: Whether the Resource Navigator could connect the caller to a service for this need. 't' or 'f'.
